headline: Communications & Content Specialist
summary: Creative communications professional with 4 years of experience in digital storytelling and brand management in the Nepali market. Proven track record in scaling social media engagement and managing cross-platform content campaigns.

experiences.title: Content Marketing Executive
description: Developed and executed content strategies for social media platforms, resulting in a 25% increase in organic reach.
Collaborated with the design team to create engaging visual content for seasonal promotional campaigns.
Managed email marketing newsletters reaching over 50,000 subscribers in the Kathmandu Valley.

experiences.title: Junior Copywriter
description: Authored compelling product descriptions and promotional copy for high-traffic e-commerce campaigns.
Maintained brand voice consistency across all digital channels during the 11.11 and 12.12 sales events.
Worked closely with the SEO team to optimize website content for better search engine rankings.

experiences.title: Editorial Intern / Campus Correspondent
description: Reported on campus events and student-led initiatives at St. Xavier's College.
Drafted and edited weekly opinion pieces, gaining experience in rapid turnaround editorial processes.
Assisted senior editors with fact-checking and archival research for feature stories.
